content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency breach detected for streaming endpoint `/v1/stream/generate` (model: llama-13B) in eu-west-2. p95 ~420ms -> 1.1s, p99 ~2.6s -> 11.8s over the last 3m. Streaming stalls reported by multiple clients. Paging oncall.
alice-oncall: I'm on it. Observed spike correlates with increased retransmits on SNAT nodes. Creating triage thread here.
ben-neteng: seeing SYN-ACK RTT jump and a small packet-loss bump between azb->azc (internal path). TCP retransmit rate on egress hosts up ~6x. Sharing tcpdump sample to PagerDuty thread.
carla-sre: customer impact: a handful of high-throughput customers (IDs 893, 1245) report streaming freezes and timeouts. Devon pls confirm support tickets and severity.
devon-support: confirmed. 3 customers with live traffic reported stalls; two hit user-visible timeouts, one got repeated chunked responses then final reset. Opening high-priority CS tickets and contacting the affected customers. Morgan (customer) is on the thread.
morgan-customer: we're seeing token streaming stop mid-response ~60-70% of requests during spike window. Our retries create duplicate completions. Can you fallback to older model or region?

frank-eng: quick check — runtime traces show requests get to the server, tokens generated in backend, but the stream sender stage blocks while waiting on TLS socket flush. stack: runtime -> async-writer -> net-socket (blocked). Looks like egress layer dropping/queueing.
alice-oncall: mitigation plan A: 1) shift a subset of traffic away from eu-west-2 to eu-west-1 for impacted customers 2) scale SNAT pool + spin up additional egress nodes 3) temp conntrack/tcp param tuning; testing canary now.
ben-neteng: confirmed conntrack table on snat-03 is at 97% of nf_conntrack_max. We have heavy ephemeral port reuse and many TIME_WAIT due to retry patterns. Runbook checks: `sudo conntrack -L | wc -l` => 329k, `sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max` => 340k. Also `ss -s` shows many retransmits.
carla-sre: actioning A1 (region shift) now via traffic-router: `route-rule add --match region=eu-west-2 --percent=10 --to eu-west-1` then increase to 30% if stable. Tracking latency after 60s.
deploy-bot: deploy started: routing change to move 10% of streaming traffic (id: rt-3382).
alice-oncall: also applying temporary kernel bump on snat fleet: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=700000` and reduce established timeout to free entries faster: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=600`. Doing on two nodes first.
ben-neteng: warning — kernel bump will free headroom but won't solve underlying packet loss. I'm deploying an egress iptables rule to avoid SNAT overload: `-m connbytes --connbytes 1:1000000 --connbytes-dir both` as temp throttle for hot connections.
carla-sre: after 10m of 10% shift: p99 across stream endpoints in eu-west-2 dropped from 11.8s -> 3.2s, retransmits down ~40%. Increasing shift to 35%.
morgan-customer: thanks, we're seeing improvement but still occasional stalls. Can you let us know ETA for full fix?
devon-support: communicated mitigation progress to customer, asked to keep retries low for next 30m. Escalated to account exec.
frank-eng: digging into NAT metrics — ephemeral port exhaustion pattern: clients with aggressive reconnects used up ephemeral ports on single SNAT IP causing resets for other flows. Long-term: we should enable port-preserving SNAT or add ephemeral port pooling. Filed RFC: infra#452.
ben-neteng: starting additional SNAT instances (snat-07/08) and attaching them to the egress pool. This should reduce per-ip port pressure. ETA ~3m for BGP updates.
alice-oncall: while that deploys, enabling prefix-pinning fallback in router to avoid reassigning live streams across different SNATs mid-stream. `routerctl set stream.pin true`.
carla-sre: note: there are also intermittent DNS resolution spikes hitting our internal resolver from eu-west-2 which increase initial handshake delays. `dig` shows 200ms vs 20ms usually. Ben, can you check DNS forwarders?
ben-neteng: yes DNS forwarders to cloud-dns were flapping for a subset of nodes — increased retries due to packet loss. I've switched those nodes to backup resolver and RTT normalized.
frank-eng: for streams that already got stalled, we can do a graceful reconnect at app-level: detect stalled progress >5s and attempt reconnect-with-resume token. Preparing patch to client-sender lib to reduce duplicates.
alice-oncall: status update 25m in: snat scale + conntrack bump + routing shift + DNS failover = p95 ~350ms, p99 ~900ms. Still above SLO but much improved. Continuing monitoring. Calling this mitigated, not resolved. Opening post-incident to dig root cause.
devon-support: customers notified: 3 impacted customers, all are in contact, two accepted region-shift for now, one requested a timeline for full fix.
morgan-customer: appreciate the transparency. Please include whether this is likely to recur.
ben-neteng: preliminary root cause hypotheses: (1) concentrated client reconnect pattern causing ephemeral port exhaustion on a subset of SNAT IPs (2) transient cross-AZ packet loss causing TCP retransmits and queueing (3) DNS flapping exacerbated handshake latency. We'll run packet captures and AS path checks overnight.
carla-sre: immediate follow-ups for oncall runbook: 1) permanent increase nf_conntrack_max across fleet with careful limits 2) add more SNAT IPs and enable port pooling 3) improve router to distribute long-lived streams across SNATs 4) monitoring: add alert for conntrack >75% and SNAT port-use >70%.
frank-eng: I'll draft an API-level mitigation: if streaming handshake doesn't complete within 2s, fail fast and trigger routed retry to alternate region. Will prototype today.
alice-oncall: handing over to carla for full RCA/next steps. I'm logging incident as Sev2 in the tracker (INC-2026-134). Oncall rotation note: carla you're primary now.
carla-sre: taking over. Will coordinate postmortem and timeline. Assigning owners: ben (network fix), frank (client resilience + server fallback), infra (snat autoscale + conntrack tuning), devon (customer comms).
deploy-bot: routing increase completed: eu-west-2 -> eu-west-1 at 35% (rt-3382). SNAT scaling completed: snat-07/08 added to pool. Kernel params applied to snat-03/04.
alice-oncall: closing paging circle: no new pages in last 12m, monitoring for next 2h. If regress to >p99 2s for 3 consecutive mins, escalate to Sev1.
morgan-customer: thanks. We'll watch and will reopen if we see issues. Appreciate the rapid response. :thumbsup:
carla-sre: end-of-thread notes: postmortem will include timeline, mitigations, and long-term fixes. Attaching perf graphs and sample tcpdump to the incident doc.
